review: Reviewed delta propagates Effect Crypto through capture-dependent Git operations; Git argument and parsing behavior are unchanged by this delta.

Structured capture separates stderr from stdout. Shared structuredCapture still trims and bounds decoded text; raw Git output uses the separate untrimmed route. NUL parsing alone does not prove byte-preserving capture.
Git calls read repository/index/config state; ensureOriginMain can fetch remote refs and write local Git state. Freshness and external authority are not pure file-computation inputs.

Adds capture-shape selection: the default merges streams and trims; runRepoCommandCaptureRaw selects stdout and disables trimming. Both extend the ambient environment, inherit stdin, and retain the repo-run output bound.

Native controls preserve leading whitespace and NUL in raw text and exclude stderr, while default capture trims and merges. Invalid UTF-8 becomes replacement characters in both modes; oversized output sets truncated and includes a notice.
Corrected byte-for-byte documentation to decoded-text semantics; no runtime behavior was changed by this review. Callers needing complete output must inspect truncated.

limits: Synthetic capture controls do not establish arbitrary filename preservation, raw byte fidelity, transitive input closure, or hosted freshness.
Six native subprocess controls were run with only PATH, HOME and CI explicitly supplied to the parent. No signed remote replay or cache qualification is established.
